Democrats have captured one of their largest polling leads over Republicans on the generic congressional ballot this cycle, some 50 days out from the midterm elections. Respondents backed the Dems over the GOP 54%-46%, as President Trump proved to be a motivating factor for both sides of the aisle, according to a CBS News/YouGov survey of adults. Instead, they’re doing it to oppose Trump, the poll found. A whopping 80% of those who said they’re voting for Democrats are doing so to oppose Trump, compared to 19% who said it’s not about him.
